command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `TEMP_CX7_1~4_Trans` read does not enumerate four resources, and the truncated OOB SDR fallback omits IB, full Sensor List and Web coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete command views and four exact Web identities keyed to approved adapter-port-module topology, with module presence and link context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five interfaces, four transceiver sensors and timing metadata remain; generic clear, literal-range and truncated evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a four-row matrix keyed by physical adapter port and installed optical module, including presence/link state, telemetry source, five timestamped views and transceiver-limit result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable optical-module identity, module/link context and full interface collection beyond generic text filtering.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A controller chip or a transceiver on a different port can show a plausible temperature while the intended optical module is absent or unmapped.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Port labels may differ between BMC, NIC firmware and chassis documentation; the approved hardware map controls identity.

project_override_considerations: Define four expected optical-module resources, CX7 adapter/port relationship, supported module-presence state, fields, limits and tolerance. Controller-chip evidence remains separate; private Script use requires pinned review.

Module presence/link/load context and approved transceiver SPEC

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target four CX7 transceiver sensors across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek's incomplete collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, exact member set, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if physical module identities cannot be distinguished from controller or other port resources after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Turns a range-like single query into a port- and module-bound four-resource five-view contract while keeping controller-junction evidence separate.
independent_technical_reasoning: Optical-module temperature follows module presence, port and link conditions and is not interchangeable with CX7 controller junction temperature. A plausible value without adapter-port-module binding can therefore validate the wrong device; four explicit mappings and complete views are required.
